meaning.zh:
“正牌货” 或 “真品”。

这个短语的起源众说纷纭，但其中一个著名的说法是，源于19世纪苏格兰非法酿酒商件案的标记。为了区分其他冒牌酒，人们开始用这个标记代表真正高质量的酒。这种标记逐渐演变成了 “Real McCoy” 这个短语，用来表示真品、原版没有掺假的物品或人。
meaning.en: There are various theories about the origin of this phrase, one famous version dates back to a 19th-century Scottish illegal whiskey dealer case involving quality assurance marks. To distinguish genuine high-quality liquor from fakes, people began using this mark. This gradually evolved into the phrase "Real McCoy," used to indicate genuine, unadulterated items or people.

lines.en: This vintage watch is the *Real McCoy*, not a replica.
lines.zh: 这只古董手表是正牌货，不是仿制品。

lines.en: When it comes to Italian pizza, this restaurant serves the *Real McCoy*.
lines.zh: 说到意大利披萨，这家餐厅提供的是真品。

lines.en: She wanted an authentic experience, the *Real McCoy*, not just a touristy version.
lines.zh: 她想要的是一次真实的体验，不是一个商业化的版本。
